submitted.title: You're on our radar.
submitted.p1: We're keeping the Founding Roster intentionally small so we can work closely with every member.
submitted.p2: Your application has been received and will be personally reviewed. If there's a fit, we'll reach out with next steps.

hero.title: The Founding Roster
hero.subtitle: For the ones building what's next.
hero.description: Player One IQ is selecting its first group of creators and organizations to help shape the platform before public launch.

thesis.title: Gaming became a career.
thesis.p1: Creators are building audiences, businesses, teams, partnerships, and careers across platforms that were never designed to work together.
thesis.p2: Player One IQ is building the operating system for the professional creator economy, starting with gaming.

lookingFor.title: We're not looking for the biggest creators.
lookingFor.subtitle: We're looking for the ones serious about becoming them.
lookingFor.description: Follower count isn't what gets you into the Founding Roster. We're looking for creators who are actively building, consistently creating, and serious about turning content into a career.
signals: Working with brands, teams, editors, or collaborators
Willing to actively use Player One IQ and give candid feedback

items.title: 12 months of Player One IQ Pro
items.body: Founding Creators receive complimentary Pro access during pre-launch plus 12 months beginning at public launch.

items.title: Permanent founding status
items.body: Your account will permanently show that you were part of the group that helped shape Player One IQ before launch.

items.title: Direct founder access
items.body: Direct access to the team building Player One IQ for feedback, ideas, bugs, and product conversations.

items.title: Product influence
items.body: Help determine what we build next, test new functionality early, and tell us what creators actually need.

items.title: Early feature access
items.body: Founding members get first access to new functionality as the Player One IQ ecosystem expands.

items.title: Founding creator spotlights
items.body: Selected members may be featured across Player One IQ social channels and community. Participation is optional.

nominations.title: Build the roster with us.
nominations.description: Activated Founding Creators unlock two nominations for creators they believe belong in the Founding Roster.
nominations.disclaimer: A nomination does not guarantee acceptance. Every member of the Founding Roster is reviewed by Player One IQ.
nominations.sampleText: You've been nominated for the Player One IQ Founding Roster.

builders.title: We don't need promoters.
builders.subtitle: We need builders.
lines: We don't expect you to post about Player One IQ.
We don't need you to pretend everything is perfect.
builders.closing: Help us build something creators actually want.

organizations.title: Building a team?
organizations.description: We're also selecting five Founding Organizations to help shape the organization side of Player One IQ.
benefits: 12 months of Organization Pro beginning at public launch
